Thanks for the ping, Ben.

Quick summary of what I'm seeing from the ops side: the screenshot looks like a classic tenant-alias mismatch — the invite was issued with an alias that doesn't match the prefill mapping in our onboarding service, so the JWT that arrives at Coupa lacks the tenant claim we use to surface vendor metadata (bank info, tax docs). That would explain empty prefill. The upload rejection could be a separate S3/content-type policy or a filename sanitization error we apply during the temporary upload proxy.

Rafael, can you run a trace for the invite token in the attached screenshot (I cropped the link). I need the onboarding-service logs for the token exchange and the Coupa callback logs. If tenant claim is missing we should:
- Reissue a new invite with tenant_alias set to "copperton-supplies" (matches Copperton's Coupa tenant id)
- Set Content-Type explicitly in the temporary upload proxy for user file uploads (pdf -> application/pdf)
- Validate that the prefill payload contains bank_account and tax_documents keys

I've attached the command I usually run to pull the onboarding-service audit for invites — run it with the token id and drop the output in the ticket.

Monica Patel
Supplier Onboarding Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachment: request_logs_command.txt

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 18:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Unable to complete onboarding — bank details missing in portal

Thanks — I pulled the trace and the onboarding token indeed shows a missing "tenant" claim at the time of redirect to Coupa. The invite was generated by an older automation run that defaulted tenant_alias to "copperton" (no suffix). Copperton's Coupa tenant expects the alias "copperton-supplies" so the mapping didn't match and prefill was skipped.

Actions I took:
- Created a new invite token and set tenant_alias=copperton-supplies (token id: reinvite-9bf3). Attached the token body for ops to include in the re-invite email.
- Adjusted the temporary upload proxy to force Content-Type=application/pdf on uploads that end with .pdf (deploy patch will go out in 30 minutes).
- Opened infra ticket INF-7923 to add a QA check to onboarding automation so alias mapping is validated before sending.

Monica, please re-send the invite using token reinvite-9bf3. Ben, once Monica confirms, could you ping Laura with the new invite? Recommend they accept on a non-mobile browser (Chrome/Edge) and try the upload again.

Attachment: reinvite_token.txt

-rm
Rafael Mendes
Platform Engineering (Onboarding Services)
Redwood Inference
